page.layout: One block of running text within a decorative border, full width. Running head at the top, with the page number 43 at its right. No notes, catchword or signature. Faint show-through and the neighbouring page at the left edge are not transcribed.

main_text.p: versaliffimum, tanquam feptimū & perfectiffimum proficifcatur quod ex fuamet ipfius propria radice,id eft terra & aqua, oriatur,eoq; & Lapidem Philofophorum ipfum antecellat, ut pote ex quo unico tum Lapis ipfe, tum reliqua omnia particulariter tingentia, initialiter fint orta: Imo ex quo omnes reliquæ totius Mundi res, non folùm in regno Minerali, fed etiam in Vegetabili & Animali vitam fuam acceperunt, & adhûc retinent,& à Creatore ad incrementum ordinatæ funt. Hoc verò cujusmodi fit, & qua in refitum,&fi ex fuperioribus utcunq; coniici poteft (lineâ viridi ubiq; gyrante) tamen etiam infra plura de hac re dicemus.

page.notes: The ornamental border is decoration and is not transcribed. The word "versaliffimum" at the top is a line fragment that continues from the previous page. Some letters in the lower lines are faint, but the readings are clear. Printed spellings such as "funt", "feptimū" and "refitum" are kept as printed.
